result.summary: I found 2 visually noticeable issues: one likely navigation-state bug and one minor layout clipping issue.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights "Profile" as the active tab, but the screen content is clearly the home/feed page. This makes the current state look wrong and can confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the selected bottom-nav item matches the current screen route, and update the highlighted state when the home feed is shown.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant/category rows appear clipped at the right edge, with the last chip/card partially cut off on screen.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer spacing or padding so partially visible items look intentional, or adjust the carousel width so the first/last items are less awkwardly cropped.
